payload.justification: The door is locked and I carry no item. The box is a visible closed container that may hold a usable key-like item.
payload.expected_outcome: The box opens and reveals its contents, which may include an item that can unlock the door.

plan: Open the box to see its contents.
If a usable item is inside, pick it up.
Unlock the door with a matching item.
